user.title: Connect RotaCloud
user.description: Employee attendance is visible to authorised Home Assistant users. HA terminal clocking is optional and requires an administrator account.

data.enable_clocking: Enable live HA terminal clocking (administrators only)

data_description.late_minutes: Grace after scheduled start before an unclocked employee is marked Late. Does not change attendance or payroll.
data_description.leaving_minutes: Minutes before scheduled finish to mark a clocked-in employee as Leaving.
data_description.clock_in_early_minutes: Show this timing pill only when the difference exceeds this many minutes. Display only; attendance is unchanged.
data_description.clock_in_late_minutes: Show this timing pill only when the difference exceeds this many minutes. Display only; attendance is unchanged.
data_description.clock_out_early_minutes: Show this timing pill only when the difference exceeds this many minutes. Display only; attendance is unchanged.
data_description.clock_out_late_minutes: Show this timing pill only when the difference exceeds this many minutes. Display only; attendance is unchanged.
data_description.break_under18_minimum_minutes: Set to 0 to disable warnings for this age band. Minimum recorded break time required in the current clocking.
data_description.break_under18_qualifying_hours: Actual work in the current clocking, excluding recorded breaks. Combine the hours and minutes fields.
data_description.break_under18_qualifying_minutes: Actual work in the current clocking, excluding recorded breaks. Combine the hours and minutes fields.
data_description.break_under18_warning_hours: Elapsed time since the current clock-in, including breaks. A warning appears only when the qualifying work time is also reached and the minimum break is not met.
data_description.break_under18_warning_minutes: Elapsed time since the current clock-in, including breaks. A warning appears only when the qualifying work time is also reached and the minimum break is not met.

data_description.break_adult_warning_hours: Elapsed time since the current clock-in, including breaks. A warning appears only when the qualifying work time is also reached and the minimum break is not met.
